_doc: Scouting probes behind docs/plans/book-detector-pale-background.md. Measured 2026-08-28; NO code was changed - the sat_max/val_min variants were monkeypatched in-process and discarded. These are the numbers that rule options in and out before Phase 2 starts.

baseline.note: de_01/de_02 abstain at 85%/89%; the 13 flat spreads at 97-100%

failing_captures.source: jobs/20260828-092505-15c41a76 (gitignored - Phase 0 must copy these into testset/)

page_001.verdict: wrong cut; the two cues that agreed with each other (pinch+shadow, 62px apart) were ~1000px from the shipped answer

page_002.verdict: no cut at all; pinch cue assumes a dark background so Otsu inverts on a pale sofa

hsv_knob_sweep._doc: emit-box area as a fraction of frame; >= 0.83 trips the abstain gate, i.e. detection failed. Rows are val_min, columns sat_max.
hsv_knob_sweep.finding: val_min is inert (identical down every column); sat_max is the whole story

global_sat_max_retune_REJECTED._doc: sat_max 0.12 fixes both real captures but destroys the suite. This closes 'retune the threshold' as an option.

sat_max_0.12.worst_case: zoomset_en_01 loses 100% of its labelled book

global_sat_max_retune_REJECTED.conclusion: no single global saturation constant serves both corpora; the fix must be per-image adaptivity, a different cue, or escalation

band_edge_margins._doc: distance of the ink-profile argmin from the nearest edge of the [0.30,0.70] search band, as a fraction of band width, ON THE SHIPPED PATH (book crop applied where find_book says so). A first attempt measured this on full frames and was wrong for the four cropped fixtures.

trap.why_safe: resolves by pinch, not ink, so a guard scoped to the DECIDING cue leaves it untouched

valley_ratio.trap: en_coins_02's pinch depth is only 0.05, so if a tighter ink gate drops it to Layer 2 there is no net and it becomes a single-page regression; zoomset_de_01 has one (pinch 0.22)

background_first_probe._doc: Owner's proposal, probed 2026-08-28: model the BACKGROUND from a 2% frame-border strip (Lab, Mahalanobis distance), Otsu the distance map, take the largest blob that is unlike the border. Throwaway prototype, no code shipped. Reports box area as a fraction of frame; the current detector abstains at >= 0.83.

page_002.verdict: would crop; visually a tight, correct box on the book

but_breaks_tight_frames._why: on a tightly-framed spread the frame border IS the page, so the background model is seeded on paper and the largest 'unlike the border' blob is something INSIDE the page
but_breaks_tight_frames.caught_by_existing_guard: min_area_frac 0.10 already rejects the four tiny ones
but_breaks_tight_frames.conclusion: needs a PRECONDITION test -- is there a background at all? -- not a tighter area guard

edge_strength_at_900px._doc: is there a border to detect on the pale-sofa frame? gradient magnitude per channel, page_002
